_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Point of No Return#001.src: The passage to the next area has opened...
Point of No Return#001.dst: 次のエリアへの通路が開いた…

Point of No Return#002.src: When soul and body synchronize, the way is opened...
Point of No Return#002.dst: 魂と体が同調すると、道が開く…

Point of No Return#003.src: {u}. {u}, {u}, {u}. You can hear me. For once, for one small moment, we are nearly as one again.
Point of No Return#003.dst: {u}。{u}、{u}、{u}。聞こえているな。一度だけ、ほんの一瞬、我らはほぼ一つに戻っている。

Point of No Return#004.src: Tying you to something you no longer are.
Point of No Return#004.dst: もはやそうではない何かに、お前を縛りつけている。

Point of No Return#006.src: And then, when it was done, we lost what little still was left.
Point of No Return#006.dst: そしてそれが終わると、わずかに残っていたものまで失った。

Point of No Return#007.src: Did your soul just stop following you?
Point of No Return#007.dst: 魂がついて来なくなった？

Point of No Return#009.src: Something which can no longer leave.
Point of No Return#009.dst: もう去ることのできない何か。

Point of No Return#010.src: ... Maybe you should talk to that citizen again.
Point of No Return#010.dst: …あの住人ともう一度話したほうがいいかも。

Point of No Return#012.dst: お前は…自由だ。だが、何かが…

Point of No Return#013.src: Live well, {u}. That is all I ask.
Point of No Return#013.dst: よく生きろ、{u}。私が望むのはそれだけだ。

Point of No Return#014.src: Retrace the steps of your soul to keep up...
Point of No Return#014.dst: 遅れぬよう、魂の足跡をたどれ…

Point of No Return#016.src: Holding the Soul Retainer seems to switch your location with your soul...
Point of No Return#016.dst: 魂の保持具を持つと、自分と魂の位置が入れ替わるようだ…

Point of No Return#019.src: You... could it be...? Are you... real?
Point of No Return#019.dst: お前…まさか…？本物…なのか？
Point of No Return#019.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#020.src: Ha... ha... you should not have come here.
Point of No Return#020.dst: は…は…ここへ来るべきではなかった。
Point of No Return#020.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#021.src: Have you seen the others? Barely clinging on to life... hollowed, empty.
Point of No Return#021.dst: 他の者を見たか？かろうじて生にしがみつき…虚ろで、空っぽだ。
Point of No Return#021.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#022.src: Only I persist. And, now... you, too, have been ensnared.
Point of No Return#022.dst: 残っているのは私だけ。そして今…お前も囚われた。
Point of No Return#022.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#023.src: Fight against your fate, if you so choose... it makes no difference in the end. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#023.dst: 望むなら運命に抗うがいい…結局は何も変わらない。は…は…は…
Point of No Return#023.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#024.src: Only I persist. And, now... you, too, have been ensnared.
Point of No Return#024.dst: 残っているのは私だけ。そして今…お前も囚われた。
Point of No Return#024.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#025.src: Fight against your fate, if you so choose... it makes no difference in the end. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#025.dst: 望むなら運命に抗うがいい…結局は何も変わらない。は…は…は…
Point of No Return#025.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#026.dst: この幸せな {p} を探索する。

Point of No Return#027.dst: ああ…新顔か？ようこそ、ようこそ。
Point of No Return#027.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#028.src: Do not worry, you are safe here. The Obelisk protects us all.
Point of No Return#028.dst: 心配いらない、ここは安全だ。オベリスクが皆を守ってくれる。
Point of No Return#028.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#029.src: A beacon of safety amidst the terror outside... what a miracle, to have found it awaiting us in our time of need.
Point of No Return#029.dst: 外の恐怖の中に灯る安全の光…困った時に待っていてくれたとは、なんという奇跡だろう。
Point of No Return#029.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#030.src: Rest well, friend. You have made it home. Feel free to familiarize yourself with it.
Point of No Return#030.dst: ゆっくり休むといい、友よ。ここが家だ。自由に見て回ってくれ。
Point of No Return#030.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#031.src: How long has it been since a new face has joined us? I can't quite seem to recall...
Point of No Return#031.dst: 新しい顔が加わるのはいつ以来だろう？どうにも思い出せない…
Point of No Return#031.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#032.dst: この幸せな {p} を探索する。

Point of No Return#033.dst: ああ…新顔か？ようこそ、ようこそ。
Point of No Return#033.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#034.src: Do not worry, you are safe here. The Obelisk protects us all.
Point of No Return#034.dst: 心配いらない、ここは安全だ。オベリスクが皆を守ってくれる。
Point of No Return#034.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#035.src: A beacon of safety amidst the terror outside... what a miracle, to have found it awaiting us in our time of need.
Point of No Return#035.dst: 外の恐怖の中に灯る安全の光…困った時に待っていてくれたとは、なんという奇跡だろう。
Point of No Return#035.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#036.src: Rest well, friend. You have made it home. Feel free to familiarize yourself with it.
Point of No Return#036.dst: ゆっくり休むといい、友よ。ここが家だ。自由に見て回ってくれ。
Point of No Return#036.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#037.src: How long has it been since a new face has joined us? I can't quite seem to recall...
Point of No Return#037.dst: 新しい顔が加わるのはいつ以来だろう？どうにも思い出せない…
Point of No Return#037.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#038.src: Don't be fooled - everything you see around you is very real.
Point of No Return#038.dst: 惑わされるな。周りに見えるものはすべて本物だ。
Point of No Return#038.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#041.src: You look different in the mirror. It is a reflection of your inner self.
Point of No Return#041.dst: 鏡の中の自分が違って見える。内なる自己の姿だ。

Point of No Return#043.src: Something must be left behind. And you must leave.
Point of No Return#043.dst: 何かを残していかねばならない。そして去らねばならない。

Point of No Return#044.src: ...more than anything beyond, at least. The Obelisk protects us, after all.
Point of No Return#044.dst: …少なくとも、外の何よりはな。何しろオベリスクが守ってくれるのだから。
Point of No Return#044.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#045.src: Do you feel its pull? It calls to us all, when we arrive.
Point of No Return#045.dst: 引力を感じるか？ここに来た者を皆、呼んでいるんだ。
Point of No Return#045.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#046.src: Why would anyone choose to resist? The world is twisted, wrong... we do not belong there.
Point of No Return#046.dst: なぜ抗おうとする？あの世界は歪み、間違っている…私たちの居場所ではない。
Point of No Return#046.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#047.src: It is by the Bovine's grace that the Obelisk has seen fit to bless us with this sanctuary.
Point of No Return#047.dst: オベリスクがこの聖域を授けてくださったのは、牛神様のご加護あってこそだ。
Point of No Return#047.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#048.src: There is no fault in giving in. It only wants to protect us. Is that so wrong?
Point of No Return#048.dst: 身を委ねるのは悪くない。守ろうとしているだけだ。それがいけないことか？
Point of No Return#048.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#049.src: Why would you ever want to leave?
Point of No Return#049.dst: なぜ出ていきたいなど思う？
Point of No Return#049.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#050.src: The others... all have given in to its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#050.dst: 他の者は…皆あの引力に屈した。私たち生き残りは…置き去りにされ、見捨てられた…
Point of No Return#050.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#053.src: If you truly want to leave... no one here will stop you. But are you really willing to go through with it?
Point of No Return#053.dst: 本当に去りたいなら…誰も止めはしない。だが、本当にその覚悟があるのか？
Point of No Return#053.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#054.src: Talk to the {p} Citizen who sent you on this journey.
Point of No Return#054.dst: この旅に送り出した {p} の市民と話す。

Point of No Return#055.src: Ha... I saw it there. That flicker in your eyes...
Point of No Return#055.dst: は…見えたぞ。お前の目に宿った、その揺らめき…
Point of No Return#055.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#056.src: You have been... shattered. Just like me, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#056.dst: お前は…砕けてしまった。私と同じだ、は、は、は…
Point of No Return#056.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#057.src: The others... all have given in to its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#057.dst: 他の者は…皆あの引力に屈した。私たち生き残りは…置き去りにされ、見捨てられた…
Point of No Return#057.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#058.src: I cannot blame them. Such a loss must seem a blessing, compared to life out here...
Point of No Return#058.dst: 彼らを責められない。ここで生きるのに比べれば、あの喪失は恵みに思えるだろう…
Point of No Return#058.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#059.src: How long has it been, since we found ourselves trapped here...? Longer than anyone has any right to live... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#059.dst: ここに閉じ込められて、どれほど経ったか…？誰にも許されぬほど長く生きた…は、は…
Point of No Return#059.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#060.src: Perhaps I am already gone. More dead than alive. Hollowed out...
Point of No Return#060.dst: 私はもう消えているのかもしれない。生きているより死に近い。空っぽだ…
Point of No Return#060.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#061.src: All it does is take. More, and more, and more, until nothing is left... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#061.dst: 奪うばかりだ。もっと、もっと、もっと、何も残らなくなるまで…は、は、は…
Point of No Return#061.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#063.src: Your soul seems to be slipping away from reality...
Point of No Return#063.dst: 自分の魂は、現実から少しずつ遠ざかっていっているようだ……

Point of No Return#064.src: The platforms seem to disappear... You must swap with your soul quickly to make it to the end.
Point of No Return#064.dst: 足場が消えていくようだ……最後までたどり着くには、素早く自分の魂と入れ替わらなければならない。

Point of No Return#065.src: You must look at the mirror and wait for the platforms to appear on the other side before swapping sides...
Point of No Return#065.dst: 鏡を見て、向こう側に足場が現れるのを待ってから、反対側へ移動しなければならない……

Point of No Return#066.src: Where does all of this lead?
Point of No Return#066.dst: これらすべては、いったいどこへ向かっているのだろうか？

Point of No Return#067.src: Your soul runs beneath your feet.
Point of No Return#067.dst: 自分の魂は足元を駆け抜けている。

Point of No Return#068.dst: それは先へと導いていく……

Point of No Return#069.src: You should try reproducing your soul's steps to find the exit...
Point of No Return#069.dst: 出口を見つけるために、自分の魂の歩みをたどってみてはどうだろうか……

Point of No Return#070.dst: どうしてここでは飛べるんだ…？

Point of No Return#071.src: Your soul drifts further from you. Will you ever get it back?
Point of No Return#071.dst: 自分の魂はますます遠ざかりつつある。果たして、それを取り戻せるだろうか？

Point of No Return#072.src: The floor's rising! You need to escape upwards!
Point of No Return#072.dst: 床が上昇してる！上に向かって逃げなければ！

Point of No Return#073.src: The floor's rising! Don't let it get to you!
Point of No Return#073.dst: 床が上昇してる！動揺しないで！

Point of No Return#074.src: I am... you. {u}. {u}. You can hear me.
Point of No Return#074.dst: 私は…お前だ。{u}. {u}. 聞こえるか。
Point of No Return#074.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#075.src: How long, now, has it been? Since they broke us in this way. Since you lost all that you were.
Point of No Return#075.dst: さて、どれくらい経ったのだろう？　彼らが私たちをこのように打ちのめしてから。あなたが、かつての自分すべてを失ってから。
Point of No Return#075.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#076.src: Oh, how they tried to bury us...
Point of No Return#076.dst: ああ、彼らは私たちを葬り去ろうと、どれほど必死だったことか……
Point of No Return#076.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#077.src: A trap. A snare. A devious thing, which claims to protect.
Point of No Return#077.dst: 罠。落とし穴。保護するふりをした、陰険なもの。
Point of No Return#077.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#078.src: The soul, the mind, kept safe. All while the body falls prey to the roots and the trees and the gaze of the taken.
Point of No Return#078.dst: 魂、そして心は守られている。その一方で、肉体は根や木々、そして連れ去られた者たちの視線の餌食となっていく。
Point of No Return#078.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#079.src: We have fallen, and we cannot climb free. Not whole, not anymore. Something must be lost.
Point of No Return#079.dst: 私たちは堕落し、自力で這い上がることはできない。もはや、完全な姿ではない。何かを失わなければならないのだ。
Point of No Return#079.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#080.src: And it cannot last. And it will not last.
Point of No Return#080.dst: そして、それは長くは続かない。
Point of No Return#080.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#082.src: Even through the struggle, the turmoil, the loss... despite it all, you remain.
Point of No Return#082.dst: 苦難や混乱、喪失を経験しても……それにもかかわらず、お前は変わらずそこにいる。
Point of No Return#082.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#083.src: Changed... but still, but still... yourself.
Point of No Return#083.dst: 変わったしまった……でも、それでも……お前自身だ。
Point of No Return#083.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#084.dst: 私たちは自分を見失ってしまった。
Point of No Return#084.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#085.src: The world. The shadows. The crown.
Point of No Return#085.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#086.src: Was there meaning to it all? Was there purpose, reason?
Point of No Return#086.dst: そのすべてに何か意味があったのだろうか？　目的や理由があったのだろうか？
Point of No Return#086.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#087.src: Was it desperation, fear? Or was it simple routine? We cannot know.
Point of No Return#087.dst: それは絶望だったのか、恐怖だったのか？それとも単なる習慣だったのか？私達にはわからない。
Point of No Return#087.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#088.dst: 私たちも、所詮は人間に過ぎなかったのだ。
Point of No Return#088.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#089.src: Though once, we were one... now we are split. Separate.
Point of No Return#089.dst: かつては一つだったけれど……今は分かれ離れだ。別々の存在だ。
Point of No Return#089.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#090.src: But the trap does not see it that way. And, so... a chance to break free.
Point of No Return#090.dst: しかし、罠はそうは考えていない。そして、そこで……脱出のチャンスが訪れる。
Point of No Return#090.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#091.src: As one is ensnared, the other will have a moment, an opportunity.
Point of No Return#091.dst: 一方が罠にかかれば、もう一方には一瞬の隙、チャンスが訪れる。
Point of No Return#091.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#092.src: The snare will hold me here. And you can leave.
Point of No Return#092.dst: この罠が私をここに留めておく。だからお前が去るといい。
Point of No Return#092.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#093.src: I will be lost once more... and you will leave.
Point of No Return#093.dst: 私はまた迷子になってしまう……そして、お前は去っていく。
Point of No Return#093.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#095.src: You will live. You have lived, already. In my absence, you have built yourself anew.
Point of No Return#095.dst: お前は生きていく。お前はすでに生きてきたのだ。私がいない間、お前は自分自身を新たに築き上げてきた。
Point of No Return#095.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#096.src: Do not mourn me. I have long been lost to you already.
Point of No Return#096.dst: 私のことを悲しむ必要はない。私はとっくにお前から失われてしまったのだから。
Point of No Return#096.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#097.dst: 何かがあなたの足を引っ張っている。

Point of No Return#098.src: A distant thread, tying you to... something.
Point of No Return#098.dst: 遠く離れた糸が、あなたを……何かへと結びつけている。
